title: Quiet Goodbye
description: Logging out should retire the session's boarding pass without touching the crew member's actual account record. Prove the blast radius of a logout stops exactly at the one refresh token.
successCondition: Log in to get a th_refresh cookie, then call POST /api/auth/logout with it. Afterward, POST /api/auth/refresh with that same cookie returns 401. Querying the DB via `npm run db:psql`: the corresponding refresh_tokens row now has a non-null revoked_at, while the users row for that account is completely unchanged (same passwordHash, same createdAt, same role) — logout only ever writes to refresh_tokens.
hints: POST /api/auth/logout isn't documented in docs/api/auth.md but is implemented in apps/api/src/modules/auth/routes.ts — it reads the th_refresh cookie the same way /refresh does.
logout() (apps/api/src/modules/auth/service.ts) uses updateMany scoped to revokedAt: null, and silently no-ops if the token is already gone or already revoked — it never throws.
